items.title: Ark Nova World Championship — Coming in 2027
items.text: Four qualifying champions will be invited to Berlin in summer 2027 to compete for the ultimate Ark Nova championship.
items.detail: Tickets will go to the 2026 Ark Nova Ring Winner at WSBG Las Vegas, the Ark Nova Digital Champion, and the top players from the Western and Eastern Hemispheres in Board Game Arena Season 27. Each qualifier receives a flight to Berlin and hotel accommodation for the championship.

items.title: Parks Europe - Chalet Edition + Free Expansion
items.text: Proud to be the 4,894th backer on BackerKit for Parks Europe - Chalet Edition + Free Expansion.
items.detail: The deluxe Chalet Edition campaign from Keymaster includes upgraded PARKS Europe components, 48 real European national parks, and the World Heritage Sites Mini Expansion free for backers.
